links.comparator_used: No distribution-shift check; applicability estimates were compared with observed prediction accuracy across four cohorts (no direct no-check arm)
links.outcome: Detection of cohorts where predictions are unreliable (applicability vs accuracy)
links.effect: Accuracy 0.69, 0.83, 0.86, 0.53 with applicability 74%, 76%, 71%, 48% for PCD4989g(mUC), PCD4989g(mRCC), Moreno, UNC-108; the lowest applicability (48%) matched the lowest accuracy (0.53) in UNC-108
links.quote: LogitDA achieved prediction accuracies of 0.69, 0.83, 0.86, and 0.53, with corresponding applicability estimates of 74%, 76%, 71%, and 48%, respectively, correctly identifying the UNC-108 cohort as one in which predictions warrant increased caution.

design_hint: applicability check for distribution shift on new datasets
